source: Davidson et al., author preprint 10.2139/ssrn.5397073, section 3.2; published DOI 10.1016/j.joes.2026.07.020
assumptions: Standalone numerical pilot: domain dimensions, hub location, density, ramp and duration are implementation choices, not a matched wind tunnel.
Gaussian sigma=thickness/4 and cutoff=2 sigma are provisional; author case dictionaries are unavailable.
Swept area uses outer radius; inner hole excludes force support only, pending author confirmation.
Uniform cubic grid; cell-centre rotor mask, without subcell integration.
Existing MAC first-order upwind solver, no explicit viscosity or turbulence closure; slip sides/top/bottom and pressure outlet.
Paper wind-tunnel bottom is no-slip and uses k-epsilon / k-omega SST; this pilot does not reproduce those conditions.
No tower, nacelle, blade rotation, electrical power or floating platform. No accuracy or steady-state certification.
